items.title: 14.5.2 Impact of deforestation on the atmosphere (jangal kaatne ka asar) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 14.5.2, printed page 311.

blocks.text: Deforestation insanon ka jaan boojh kar jangal saaf karna ya un ke darakht kam karna hai. Deforestation global climate ke sab se bare problems mein se ek hai. Jangal CO₂ jaisi greenhouse gases (GHGs) absorb karte hain aur hamare liye hawa saaf karte hain. Short yeh ke deforestation ke environment par bohat se bure effects (asar) hain, jaise biodiversity (jandaron ki types) ka nuqsan, climate change, soil degradation (mitti ka kharab hona) aur water cycle ka bigarna.

blocks.prompt: Jangal kaatna air quality par kaise asar dalta hai?
blocks.explanation: Darakht photosynthesis se CO₂ hatate hain aur patton par dhool rokte hain. Unhen kaatne se yeh safai khatam ho jati hai, lakri mein jama carbon CO₂ ban kar nikalta hai (khaas kar jab lakri jalai jaye), aur khuli mitti se hawa dhool urati hai. Is tarah hawa zyada gandi aur greenhouse gases se bhari hoti hai.

blocks.prompt: a) Air pollution ke human (man-made) sources batayein.
blocks.explanation: Mobile sources: cars, trucks, hawai jahaz aur samandari engines. Point sources: factories aur bijli ghar. Yeh sab fossil fuels jala kar CO₂, CO aur hydrocarbons chhorte hain. Ghar mein lakri jalana aur bhattiyon mein coal jalana bhi.

blocks.prompt: b) PAHs zyada tar atmosphere mein kaise aate hain?
blocks.explanation: Fossil fuels (coal, oil, petrol, lakri) ke incomplete combustion se: gariyon ke dhuen, factories ke processes, khuli aag aur grill khane se. Kuch petroleum aur coal ke natural seepage se bhi.

blocks.prompt: c) VOCs air quality par kaise asar dalte hain?
blocks.explanation: Liquid fuels, exhaust, lakri aur koora jalne se VOCs gas ban kar hawa mein aate hain aur ghar ke andar aur bahar dono ki hawa kharab karte hain. Thori der mein aankh, naak, gale ki jalan, sar dard aur matli; lambe arse mein jigar, gurde aur nervous system ko nuqsan. Dhoop mein NOₓ ke saath mil kar yeh smog bhi banate hain.

blocks.prompt: d) Atmosphere mein heavy metals ke bare sources kya hain?
blocks.explanation: Metallurgy, battery ka koora aur incineration (koora jalana), saath factories ke processes aur transport.

items: Deforestation: CO₂ absorb karne aur hawa saaf karne wale jangal khatam; biodiversity ka nuqsan, climate change, mitti ki kharabi, water cycle ka bigarna.
